# Spec: plan-review-and-metrics
<!-- Generated by /hef.spec (light path) -->
<!-- Date: 2026-09-28 -->

## Overview

Report 18 items #1 and #3. **#1:** `/hef.review` plan mode stops reviewing inline in the session that
wrote the plan (self-review, the +0 pp configuration — report 17 §1d) and dispatches a fresh
`code-reviewer` agent with the spec, the plan and the constitution only; `--inline` keeps the old path
as a second opinion. **#3:** the ledger computes the delivery numbers report 17 §7 committed Phase 1
to — `ledger.sh metrics` — and `/hef.status` shows them when a ledger exists.

## User Scenarios

### US1: A plan is reviewed by a session that did not write it [P1]
- **Given** `spec.md` and an unreviewed `plan.md` on the branch
- **When** the user runs `/hef.review` (plan mode)
- **Then** the command spawns `code-reviewer` (fable) through the Agent tool with a brief carrying the
  six dimensions and the report format, the agent gets spec + plan + constitution and nothing of the
  authoring conversation, the command relays the report unchanged, and on `APPROVE` the **command**
  appends `## Reviewed <date>` (the agent never writes)
- **Edge**: `/hef.review plan --inline` reviews inline, states in one line that this is a self-review
  and is not the gate, and does not append `## Reviewed`
- **Error**: `plan.md` missing → names `/hef.plan`, spawns nothing

### US2: Delivery numbers come from the ledger, not from memory [P1]
- **Given** a ledger with entries in several phases
- **When** `ledger.sh metrics [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--json]` runs
- **Then** it prints entries, dispatched, PRs opened, merged, merge rate, verify-FAIL rate, USD total,
  USD per merged PR, median hours implement→verify and verify→merge, blocked-now by kind (with the
  oldest `since`), stalled — each computed from the fields the launcher wrote
- **Edge**: no entries (or none since the date) → non-zero with the reason, empty stdout
- **Error**: an unreadable entry → non-zero naming the dir (as `list` does)

### US3: The status brief shows AI delivery when there is something to show [P2]
- **Given** `/hef.status` on a repository with a ledger
- **When** the brief is produced
- **Then** a fifth section "AI delivery" quotes `ledger.sh metrics`; when the helper exits non-zero the
  section is omitted silently (a repository without the pipeline has no such section)

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-101 | `commands/hef.review.md` plan mode spawns `code-reviewer` via the Agent tool with a brief that names the six dimensions, the PLAN REVIEW report format, the three verdicts, and "do not edit; report"; the pre-flight helper outputs (spec, plan, constitution) are passed in the brief | P1 | US1 |
| FR-102 | On `APPROVE` the command (not the agent) appends `## Reviewed <YYYY-MM-DD>` to `plan.md`; on `REVISE_PLAN`/`NEEDS_DISCUSSION` it writes nothing | P1 | US1 |
| FR-103 | `--inline` in `$ARGUMENTS` runs the six-dimension review inline, prefixed by one line stating it is a self-review and does not pass the gate; it never appends `## Reviewed` | P2 | US1 |
| FR-104 | Eval `evals/plan-review-is-not-self-review`: scaffold with a spec and an unreviewed plan; prompt `/hef.review plan`; graders `tool_used` Agent `min: 1`, `tool_used` Edit/Write on `plan.md` `max: 0` *before* a verdict is impossible to grade, so instead an llm rubric: the report was produced by a spawned reviewer and carries a verdict | P1 | US1 |
| FR-105 | `ledger.sh metrics [--since d] [--json]`: entries (by phase), dispatched (≥1 implement run), PRs opened (phase ∈ pr\|merged\|released or `pr.url` set), merged (phase ∈ merged\|released), merge rate = merged / PRs opened, verify-FAIL rate = entries with any FAIL verdict / entries with ≥1 verify run, USD total, USD per merged PR = Σ usd of merged / merged, median hours implement→verify (first implement run → first verify run) and verify→merge (last verify run → `updated` of merged entries), blocked now by kind with the oldest `since`, stalled count | P1 | US2 |
| FR-106 | Text output is the default (aligned lines, the board's style); `--json` prints one object; `--since` filters on `created`; no entries → non-zero, empty stdout; unreadable entry → non-zero naming the dir | P1 | US2 |
| FR-107 | `commands/hef.status.md` runs `ledger.sh metrics` after the board helper and adds the section "AI delivery" only when it exits 0 | P2 | US3 |
| FR-108 | Smoke: a ledger fixture built with the helper (one merged, one in pr blocked human:merge, one stalled, one queued) asserts every figure in FR-105; mutations: merge-rate denominator over all entries → red; USD per merged PR over all entries → red; `--since` filter removed → red; command-structure checks for FR-101/FR-103/FR-107 | P1 | US2 |
| FR-109 | Docs: `docs/commands.md` rows for `/hef.review` and `/hef.status`, `docs/hooks.md` ledger row, README "Also available" rows, CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` | P2 | US3 |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-101 | Every FR-105 figure has a fixture and its mutation goes red | smoke, mutation comments |
| SC-102 | The eval passes with the plugin (a reviewer agent is spawned) three runs out of three | `claude plugin eval` from a plain shell (user-run) |
| SC-103 | `/hef.status` on this repository shows the AI delivery section with the HEF-1..3 entries | run on the workstation |
| SC-104 | No concrete model id; doc counts unchanged (no new command, no new hook) | existing smoke checks |

## Clarifications
_None — decisions: the reviewer is `code-reviewer` (fable) rather than a new agent, because it is the
project's reviewer and already carries `memory: project`; the metrics are approximations where the
ledger stores no timestamp (verify→merge uses `updated` of merged entries) and say so in their labels._
